library(shiny)
library(rspiro)
library(bslib)


#glith <- read.csv("glith.csv")

ui <- fluidPage(
  theme = bslib::bs_theme(bootswatch="darkly"),
  titlePanel(
    h2(style="color:orange","Global Lung Function Initiatives (GLI) 2012 for Thai"),
    ("SpiroThai Dashboard")),
    sidebarLayout(
        sidebarPanel(width=3,
          dateInput(
            "testdate",
            "วันที่ตรวจ",
            format = "yyyy-mm-dd",
            value = Sys.Date(),
            startview = "year",
            autoclose = TRUE
          ),
          selectInput(
            "sex",
            "เพศ",
            choices = c("ชาย" = 1, "หญิง" =2),
            selected = 1,
            width = "60%",
            multiple = FALSE
          ),
          dateInput(
            "DOB",
            "วันเดือนปีเกิด (ค.ศ.)",
            format = "yyyy-mm-dd",
            value = "1999-12-31",
            min = "1926-12-31",
            startview = "year",
            autoclose = TRUE
          ),
          h6("อายุ (ปี   )"  ),verbatimTextOutput("age"),
          h6(),
          sliderInput(
            "ht",
            "ส่วนสูง (ซ.ม.)",
            min = 100,
            max = 200,
            round = TRUE,
            value = 100
          ),
          hr(),
          h6(style="color:yellow","ค่าที่วัดได้"),
          h6(style="color:yellow","Measured Values"),
          numericInput("meas_FVC", "FVC (L)", 0, min=0, max=10, width='80%'),
          numericInput("meas_FEV1", "FEV1 (L)", 0, min=0, max=10, width='80%'),
          numericInput("meas_FEVFVC", "FEV1/FVC (%)", 0, min=0, max=100, width='80%'),
          numericInput("meas_FEF", "FEF25-75% (L/s)", 0, min=0, max=10, width='80%'),
          hr()
        ),
        mainPanel(width=9,
          fluidRow(h2(style="font-size:1.5em",
                      "Spirometric Reference Values")
          ),
          hr(),
          fluidRow(
            column(2,
                   h5(style="font-size:1em; color:yellow","Parameters")),
            column(2,
                   h5(style="font-size:1em; color:yellow;text-align:center","Measured")),
            column(2,
                   h5(style="font-size:1em; color:yellow;text-align:center","LLN")),
            column(2,
                   h5(style="font-size:1em; color:yellow;text-align:center","Predicted")),
            column(2,
                   h5(style="font-size:1em; color:yellow;text-align:center","%Pred")),
            column(2,
                   h5(style="font-size:1em; color:yellow;text-align:center","z-score"))
          ),
          fluidRow(
            column(2,
                   h6(style="font-size:0.8em","FVC (L)")),
            column(2,
                   h6(style="text-align:center", verbatimTextOutput("m_FVC"))),
            column(2,
                   h6(style="text-align:center", textOutput("LLN_FVC"))),
            column(2,
                   h6(style="text-align:center", textOutput("pred_FVC"))),
            column(2,
                   h6(style="text-align:center", verbatimTextOutput("pctpred_FVC"))),
            column(2,
                   h6(style="text-align:center", verbatimTextOutput("z_FVC")))
            ),
          fluidRow(
            column(2,
                   h6(style="font-size:0.8em","FEV1 (L)")),
            column(2,
                   h6(style="text-align:center",verbatimTextOutput("m_FEV1"))),
            column(2,
                   h6(style="text-align:center",textOutput("LLN_FEV1"))),
            column(2,
                   h6(style="text-align:center",textOutput("pred_FEV1"))),
            column(2,
                   h6(style="text-align:center",verbatimTextOutput("pctpred_FEV1"))),
            column(2,
                   h6(style="text-align:center",verbatimTextOutput("z_FEV1")))
          ),
          fluidRow(
            column(2,
                   h6(style="font-size:0.8em","FEV1/FVC (%)")),
            column(2,
                   h6(style="text-align:center",verbatimTextOutput("m_FEVFVC"))),
            column(2,
                   h6(style="text-align:center",textOutput("LLN_FEVFVC"))),
            column(2,
                   h6(style="text-align:center",textOutput("pred_FEVFVC"))),
            column(2,
                   h6(style="text-align:center",verbatimTextOutput("pctpred_FEVFVC"))),
            column(2,
                   h6(style="text-align:center",verbatimTextOutput("z_FEVFVC")))
          ),
          fluidRow(
            column(2,
                   h6(style="font-size:0.8em","FEF25-75% (L/s)")),
            column(2,
                   h6(style="text-align:center",verbatimTextOutput("m_FEF"))),
            column(2,
                   h6(style="text-align:center",textOutput("LLN_FEF"))),
            column(2,
                   h6(style="text-align:center",textOutput("pred_FEF"))),
            column(2,
                   h6(style="text-align:center",verbatimTextOutput("pctpred_FEF"))),
            column(2,
                   h6(style="text-align:center",verbatimTextOutput("z_FEF")))
          ),
          fluidRow(
          hr()
          ),
          h6(style="font-size:0.8em; color:grey", "LLN, lower limit of normal"),
          fluidRow(
            h6(style="font-weight:bold; color:orange; font-size:0.8em", "References:")
          ),
          fluidRow(
            p(style="font-size:0.6em; margin-top:0.2em; margin-bottom:0.2em", 
              "1. Quanjer PH, et al. Eur Respir J 2012; 40:1324–43.")
          ),
          fluidRow(
            p(style="font-size:0.6em; margin-top:0.2em; margin-bottom:0.2em", 
              "2. Lytras T (2023). _rspiro: Implementation of 
              Spirometry Equations_. R package version 0.4, 
              <https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=rspiro>.")
          )
        )
    )
  )

server <- function(input, output, session){
  age <- reactive({
    req(input$testdate, input$DOB)
    as.double(round((as.Date(input$testdate) - as.Date(input$DOB)) / 365.25, digits = 1))
  })

  output$age <- renderText({
    req(age())
    age()
  })

  output$m_FVC <- renderText({
    input$meas_FVC
  })
  output$pred_FVC <- renderText({
    req(age(), input$ht, input$sex)
    round(pred_GLI(age(), input$ht/100, as.numeric(input$sex), 4, param="FVC"), digits=3)
  })
  output$LLN_FVC <- renderText({
    req(age(), input$ht, input$sex)
    round(LLN_GLI(age(), input$ht/100, as.numeric(input$sex), 4, param="FVC"), digits=3)
  })
  output$pctpred_FVC <- renderText({
    req(age(), input$ht, input$sex)
    pctpred_FVC <- round(pctpred_GLI(age(), input$ht/100, as.numeric(input$sex), 4, FVC = input$meas_FVC), digits=1)
    ifelse(isTruthy(input$meas_FVC) && input$meas_FVC > 0, pctpred_FVC, NA)
  })
  output$z_FVC <- renderText({
    req(age(), input$ht, input$sex)
    z_FVC <- round(zscore_GLI(age(), input$ht/100, as.numeric(input$sex), 4, FVC = input$meas_FVC), digits=4)
    ifelse(isTruthy(input$meas_FVC) && input$meas_FVC > 0, z_FVC, NA)
  })
  
  output$m_FEV1 <- renderText({
    input$meas_FEV1
  })
  output$pred_FEV1 <- renderText({
    req(age(), input$ht, input$sex)
    round(pred_GLI(age(), input$ht/100, as.numeric(input$sex), 4, param="FEV1"), digits=3)
  })
  output$LLN_FEV1 <- renderText({
    req(age(), input$ht, input$sex)
    round(LLN_GLI(age(), input$ht/100, as.numeric(input$sex), 4, param="FEV1"), digits=3)
  })
  output$pctpred_FEV1 <- renderText({
    req(age(), input$ht, input$sex)
    pctpred_FEV1 <- round(pctpred_GLI(age(), input$ht/100, as.numeric(input$sex), 4, FEV1 = input$meas_FEV1), digits=1)
    ifelse(isTruthy(input$meas_FEV1) && input$meas_FEV1 > 0, pctpred_FEV1, NA)
  })
  output$z_FEV1 <- renderText({
    req(age(), input$ht, input$sex)
    z_FEV1 <- round(zscore_GLI(age(), input$ht/100, as.numeric(input$sex), 4, FEV1 = input$meas_FEV1), digits=4)
    ifelse(isTruthy(input$meas_FEV1) && input$meas_FEV1 > 0, z_FEV1, NA)
  })
  
  output$m_FEVFVC <- renderText({
    input$meas_FEVFVC
  })
  output$pred_FEVFVC <- renderText({
    req(age(), input$ht, input$sex)
    round(100 * pred_GLI(age(), input$ht/100, as.numeric(input$sex), 4, param="FEV1FVC"), digits=1)
  })
  output$LLN_FEVFVC <- renderText({
    req(age(), input$ht, input$sex)
    round(100 * LLN_GLI(age(), input$ht/100, as.numeric(input$sex), 4, param="FEV1FVC"), digits=1)
  })
  output$pctpred_FEVFVC <- renderText({
    req(age(), input$ht, input$sex)
    pctpred_FEVFVC <- round(pctpred_GLI(age(), input$ht/100, as.numeric(input$sex), 4, FEV1FVC = input$meas_FEVFVC/100), digits=1)
    ifelse(isTruthy(input$meas_FEVFVC) && input$meas_FEVFVC > 0, pctpred_FEVFVC, NA)
  })
  output$z_FEVFVC <- renderText({
    req(age(), input$ht, input$sex)
    z_FEVFVC <- round(zscore_GLI(age(), input$ht/100, as.numeric(input$sex), 4, FEV1FVC = input$meas_FEVFVC/100), digits=4)
    ifelse(isTruthy(input$meas_FEVFVC) && input$meas_FEVFVC > 0, z_FEVFVC, NA)
  })
  
  output$m_FEF <- renderText({
    input$meas_FEF
  })
  output$pred_FEF <- renderText({
    req(age(), input$ht, input$sex)
    round(pred_GLI(age(), input$ht/100, as.numeric(input$sex), 4, param="FEF2575"), digits=3)
  })
  output$LLN_FEF <- renderText({
    req(age(), input$ht, input$sex)
    round(LLN_GLI(age(), input$ht/100, as.numeric(input$sex), 4, param="FEF2575"), digits=3)
  })
  output$pctpred_FEF <- renderText({
    req(age(), input$ht, input$sex)
    pctpred_FEF <- round(pctpred_GLI(age(), input$ht/100, as.numeric(input$sex), 4, FEF2575 = input$meas_FEF), digits=1)
    ifelse(isTruthy(input$meas_FEF) && input$meas_FEF > 0, pctpred_FEF, NA)
  })
  output$z_FEF <- renderText({
    req(age(), input$ht, input$sex)
    z_FEF <- round(zscore_GLI(age(), input$ht/100, as.numeric(input$sex), 4, FEF2575 = input$meas_FEF), digits=4)
    ifelse(isTruthy(input$meas_FEF) && input$meas_FEF > 0, z_FEF, NA)
  })
}

# Run the application 
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
